s: Din layla rishona shechala beshabbat ubo b' seipim: im chal yom rishon shel sukkot lihyot beshabbat — omer hashsheliach tzibbur bearbit beraka achat meen sheba, umazkir bah shabbat veeno mazkir bah yom tob, kemo shennitbaer besiman rs"ch, ayyen sham:
En omerim "maarabit" belel rishon shechal beshabbat, ubelel sheni omerim "maarabit" shel lel rishon:
